name: Rice Flour
siboNotes: Rice flour is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's easily digestible and doesn't ferment in the small intestine. Brown rice flour may be slightly harder to digest than white rice flour.
preparationTips: Store in airtight container to prevent rancidity, especially brown rice flour
Combine with xanthan gum or guar gum for better texture in gluten-free baking
Sift before use to prevent lumps in baked goods
Toast lightly in a dry pan before use to enhance nutty flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of carbohydrates for energy
Brown rice flour provides more fiber and B vitamins
Lower protein content than wheat flour
